svg.title: Spotlight screen archetypes
svg.text: Spotlight Design Contract — 9 screen archetypes, every one of the 550+ screens maps to exactly one
Purple = the one dominant element. Same chrome everywhere: sidebar (shortcut bar · search · nav · profile/role · soundscape · language · ORB) + header bar + utility bar.
